stateOwnerDisposition: The same single-writer DurableInferenceControl journal owns legacy records and native hosted request identity, quota/resource/economic-budget holds, dispatch/final-use bindings, terminal observations and bounded native compaction archives.
terminalObserverDisposition: The actual Agent-fenced App Server client supplies matching turn observations through a trusted in-process port. Live dispatch consumes a signed final-use grant bound to the exact serialized turn. Post-crash recovery is read-only: a persisted matching Completed/Failed turn can establish terminality and release local capacity, but cannot recreate the non-serializable final-use token or retroactively report authorized success.

operations.sourceSemantics: Pins exact request identity plus cross-bound AuthBus quota/resource evidence before provider contact; enforces request, token, concurrency and conservative owner-defined economic-budget holds under one reservation.

Consumes a kernel-owned signed final-use grant bound to the exact provider/model/request/scope/payload and authority epoch, then syncs thread/provider/context/grant dispatch intent before the actual turn/start RPC; a duplicate cannot issue a new turn.
Persists interrupt intent without releasing an in-flight quota/resource/budget hold; acknowledgement is not terminality and unknown execution remains held.

Persists matching live or read-only reconciled terminal observations and optional observed usage. Terminality can release local concurrency; observed tokens refine token holds, while economic budget remains conservatively consumed without authenticated billing reconciliation. Post-crash reconciliation never replays the provider turn or reconstructs final-use authority.
